Furthermore, coordinating slides, subtitles, speech, and talker channels simultaneously proves extremely difficult. This multi-modal misalignment results in disjointed presentations that confuse the audience significantly. Therefore, specialized architectures are required to handle these unique academic presentation demands properly.

PresentQuiz tests knowledge conveyance by requiring VideoLLMs to answer paper-derived questions based on the video content. Finally, IP Memory measures how well the audience associates authors with their work, reflecting the video's impact on research visibility.
